stories.story_fr: Le Total Segment EBITDA atteint 343 M$ au T3 FY26, en hausse de 18 % sur un an, porte par Dow Jones et l'immobilier numerique.
stories.story_en: Total Segment EBITDA reached $343M in Q3 FY26, up 18% YoY driven by Dow Jones and Digital Real Estate.
stories.quote: Total Segment EBITDA was $343 million, an 18% increase compared to $290 million in the prior year

stories.story_fr: Dow Jones Risk & Compliance affiche une croissance de 19 % au T3 FY26 avec un chiffre d'affaires de 100 M$, portee par la demande en intelligence des risques.
stories.story_en: Dow Jones Risk & Compliance grew 19% to $100M in Q3 FY26, driven by demand for risk intelligence products.
stories.quote: 19% growth in Risk Compliance revenues to $100 million

stories.story_fr: Realtor.com (Move) progresse de 10 % a 148 M$ au T3 FY26, soutenu par les offres premium et de nouvelles adjacences de croissance.
stories.story_en: Realtor.com (Move) grew 10% to $148M in Q3 FY26, driven by premium offerings and new growth adjacencies.
stories.quote: Revenues at Move, operator of Realtor.com, were $148 million, a 10% increase from the prior year

stories.story_fr: News Corp signe un accord de licence contenu IA avec Meta, en complement du partenariat OpenAI, et poursuit activement les scrapers illicites pour proteger sa propriete intellectuelle.
stories.story_en: News Corp signed an AI content licensing deal with Meta, complementing its OpenAI partnership, while pursuing illicit content scrapers.
stories.signal: Accord IA Meta, partenariat OpenAI actif
stories.quote: our recent deal with Meta, which complements our partnership with OpenAI

stories.story_fr: REA Group affiche une croissance de 20 % a 325 M$ au T3 FY26, portee par les effets de change favorables et la solide performance residentielle australienne.
stories.story_en: REA Group posted 20% revenue growth to $325M in Q3 FY26, driven by FX tailwinds and strong Australian residential performance.
stories.quote: REA Group posted strong results for the quarter, growing revenues 20% to $325 million

stories.story_fr: News Corp accelere son programme de rachat d'actions a un rythme superieur a 4 fois le precedent, signal fort de la confiance du management dans la valorisation du titre.
stories.story_en: News Corp accelerated its share buyback program at over 4x the prior rate, signaling management confidence in undervalued stock.
stories.signal: Rachat actions a 4x le rythme precedent
stories.quote: we have continued to execute our enhanced buyback program at an accelerated rate
